t: You're on Whittington Avenue, a street in the City of London. It takes its name from Richard Whittington, a medieval merchant and politician who was four times Lord Mayor of London. He was also a member of parliament and a Sheriff of London. He is the real man behind the folk tale of Dick Whittington and His Cat. In his lifetime he paid for public projects, including drainage in poor areas and a hospital ward for unmarried mothers. He left his fortune to a charity that still helps people in need, more than six hundred years later.
